2026-10-15T15:18:00Z_AGGRESSIVE_MODE_IDE.the_idea_aggressive_mode: The disclosed number (16.5%) is the RUNNER TRANCHE's own return only -- the exit engine's pnlPct is computed off the current mark vs entry premium, which is a per-contract % return identical regardless of position size, so it structurally cannot reflect the OTHER two tranches banked earlier at their own (better) prices. This would be an approximation (assumes each tranche filled exactly at its trigger_pct rather than its real fill price, which isn't separately recorded -- only a 0/1/2 trims_taken COUNT is persisted, confirmed via exit-sync.ts), but likely closer to truth than reporting the runner-only number with no computed blended figure at all, only prose disclosure. Idea: surface a real 'blended (approx)' P&L number alongside the existing narrative disclosure for any trim_scale position with trims_taken > 0 exiting via a live-only reason, rather than relying on the prose sentence alone to convey it.
